    • OfferTrackCardNode

      public OfferTrackCardNode(int index, OfferTrackElement slot, Predicate<Color> highlightPredicate)
      Creates a node for the specified offer track slot.
      Parameters:
      index - the zero-based position of the slot in the offer track
      slot - the offer track slot to display
      highlightPredicate - predicate used to determine whether the slot totem is highlighted
